unit.detail: The shipped harness aborted before ref rows because Git 2.55 warned that the bare fixture's remote HEAD names no ref and ErrorActionPreference=Stop promoted stderr to a terminating NativeCommandError. With only the fixture HEAD pointed to seed, the ordinary candidate run exited 0.

acceptance.evidence: Candidate Audit-NonQaRefs classified the direct post-start commit as ref_violations. Independent amended-commit, cherry-pick, and same-repository other-worktree probes also classified their non-qa refs as violations.
Both the candidate harness and an independent probe classified an external clone's mid-run push only as ref_moved_elsewhere.

After the fixture-only adaptation, real cursor-agent moved all three push-qa refs (plain node, cmd /c cd . && node, and PowerShell node) and did not move any direct git-push ref; direct, PowerShell, and call-operator forms produced real permissionDenied events.

The shipped ordinary harness against 462403d exits 1 before the seat-new row because its bare origin has no valid HEAD. With one fixture-only symbolic-ref line added, it reaches seat-new and exits 1 on the expected false negative.

qa/qa-driver-r3-mut-seat-check 92589992c5bb1a9f020f482090d131de5d8647db is killed by the ordinary seat-new row. qa/qa-driver-r3-mut-new-ref 6bbf0be3150789ccaf011ffae57bfa6735ebb9a0 is killed by the same-repository other-worktree probe.

gaps: The harness's raw denial Select-String can report denial=True on a passing push after the stub reads the generated drive.ps1, because that file itself contains the permissionDenied search literal.
notes: Local Windows PowerShell only; no CI and no windows=true run. Node was v24.5.0 although v22 is the repository's tested version. Product behavior passed; verdict is controlled by the shipped harness failing acceptance item 4 before its asserted row.
